_note: How the game feels (src/gameFeel.ts, docs/GAME_DESIGN.md section 19): what the player sees and how the view moves, never the simulation. day: a whole day's real seconds at 1x, 2x and 3x, and nightPace, how many times as fast the night goes (the player's settings make the day half or twice as long). weather: how fast the 3D weather follows the month's, a share a second (0.1 is about 20 to 30 s), for cloud, rain, fog, smoke and storm, and how fast the ground gets wet in rain (wetting) and dries after it (drying). camera: the smart camera's view for each kind of tool (paint brushes, line tools, buildings, buying land): pitchDeg, its tilt above the horizon, and widthM, the metres of ground across the screen; glideSeconds, how long its glide takes; still…, how near the camera may already be (degrees of tilt, share of distance, degrees of heading) for it not to move. edge: the thin band at the screen's edge that slides the camera away from drawing (bandPx wide, after bandDwellMs of rest, bandSpeed pixels a second, a building in hand at bandBuildingShare of it), and the wide margin while a line is drawn (edgePx, edgeSpeed). Edited by the owner on the admin page (admin.html, npm run dev); a missing or wrong number plays as the game comes.
